An [[Engineer/Legends|engineered]] biological by-product, '''porrh''' was used by members of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to sterilize wounds.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III||Porrh}}</ref> In [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], former [[Executor (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|Executor]] [[Nom Anor]] used a porrh wash to sterilize a [[Limb/Legends|leg]] injury the [[Shamed Ones|Shamed One]] [[Kunra]] had received on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Remnant" />

==Behind the scenes==
Porrh first appeared in the novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]'', written by [[Sean Williams]] and [[Shane Dix]] and released in [[2003]].<ref name="Remnant" /> It received an entry for itself in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which was put out in [[2008]].<ref name="TCSWE" />
